phase: FINAL — READY-or-RETIRE closure, single canonical authority
authority_statement: This file is the sole canonical economics authority for the FENO top-down Index RIM. Where any other committed criteria artifact disagrees, this file wins. Every superseded file is preserved unedited and listed under supersedes with its content hash. No implementation may restate these economics by hand; the runtime must read this file or mechanically assert parity against it.

why_this_file_exists.measured_split_at_freeze: Three committed artifacts disagreed about the canonical terminal, and the committed runtime implemented a fourth position — the oldest one.
evidence: feno-index-rim-v1-criteria-v2.json .terminal.formula = CV3 = Terminal_RI_4 / Ke_s  (candidate A, zero growth)
feno-index-rim-e5-criteria-v2.json .candidate_B_frozen.terminal = CV3 = RI_4 / (Ke - g), g = Rf(t0)  (candidate B, g pinned to Rf)
scripts/build-rim-index-e5.mjs line 97 = ((ltroe - ke) * B3) / (ke - g)  (candidate B)
why_this_file_exists.materiality_of_the_split: The two committed implementations disagree about the product's headline number by roughly 48 percent on SPX. Committed FENO_RIM_CURRENT_SPX.json Base is 4384.88 from the candidate-A runtime; the E6 adjudicated Base is 6493.81 from the candidate-B script. Both were committed simultaneously. This alone made R1 unsatisfiable before this file existed.
why_this_file_exists.which_side_this_file_takes: Candidate B, because the terminal adjudication (FENO_RIM_TERMINAL_ADJUDICATION.md, ab46a51077) froze B as Base against gates that were themselves frozen first. Candidate A is not revived, and the choice is not re-opened here. What this file changes is only g, per the contract's single permitted bounded terminal repair.
why_this_file_exists.not_permission_to_retune: This file was written and committed before any new valuation was computed. The freeze receipt asserts the result paths did not exist at freeze time.

notation.B0: index-level book value per index point at the benchmark as-of date
notation.eps[t]: FY1, FY2, FY3 consensus index earnings per index point, t = 1..3
notation.payout: index payout ratio, Route A primary
notation.ke: cost of equity for the cell = Rf + ERP_cell
notation.LTROE: normalized long-run index return on equity for the cell

equations.book_roll_forward: B[t] = B[t-1] + eps[t] * retention, for t = 1..3, starting from B0
equations.explicit_residual_income: RI[t] = eps[t] - ke * B[t-1], for t = 1..3

primary_source.name: Federal Reserve FOMC Summary of Economic Projections
primary_source.verification: Read directly from the released PDF by the handler on 2026-08-08, not from a secondary summary.

rf_at_freeze.source: macro/fred-banking-daily.json series.DGS10, latest finite observation at freeze time
rf_at_freeze.rule: Rf is the latest finite DGS10 observation available at freeze time. The value and its as-of date are recorded here so the choice cannot move after a result.

stable_growth.g_base_binding_side: g_macro binds; Rf is the non-binding upper bound at this freeze.
stable_growth.why_min: Damodaran is methodology authority for the boundary: perpetual stable growth must be consistent with long-run economy growth, and the risk-free rate is an upper-bound rule of thumb rather than a target. min() applies the economy constraint first and keeps Rf as a cap.
stable_growth.what_changed_from_the_old_candidate_B: The old candidate B set g = Rf = 4.63 percent, which used the cap as the central estimate. This file sets the central estimate from official long-run macro projections and keeps Rf only as the cap. At this freeze that lowers g by 65 basis points.

cross_check_disclosed_not_averaged.source: Congressional Budget Office Long-Term Budget Outlook
cross_check_disclosed_not_averaged.figure: average annual real GDP growth about 1.6 percent over the long-run projection window
cross_check_disclosed_not_averaged.treatment: Disclosed as sensitivity only. The Fed SEP rule stays canonical per the contract. The CBO variant falls inside the frozen plus-or-minus 100 basis point shadow band below, so it is already covered by the robustness gate rather than needing a separate decision.
cross_check_disclosed_not_averaged.verification_status: attributed to CBO via published search result, not independently re-derived from the CBO data file

stable_growth.historical_origins: If historical QA ever runs, each origin uses the latest official long-run projection genuinely knowable at that origin. The 2026 projection is never backfilled into an earlier origin.

erp.rule: centre is the current Damodaran US ERP reading; low and high are centre minus and plus 50 basis points
erp.width_rationale: the spacing repeatedly used in the primary public Yoo/Kiwoom grids; the centre moves with the live reading so no historical absolute ERP level is copied
erp.mapping: ERP low is the bull required-return state, ERP high is the bear state

ltroe.rule: median of the index ROE series over the trailing ten calendar years ending at the latest benchmark source date, after dropping non-finite values
ltroe.current_roe_is_not_ltroe: SPX 29.13 percent and NDX 41.40 percent are current readings belonging to FY1-FY3, not to perpetuity. Using them as terminal ROE is prohibited.

scenario_mapping.GRID_MEAN: arithmetic mean of all nine finite cells

payout.route_a_primary: derived.payout_ratio from the committed inputs builder
payout.rule: Route A produces every published number. Route B runs the whole grid as a materiality check and never replaces Route A.

materiality_thresholds.ordering: Bear <= Base <= Bull must hold under both routes

qqq.label: NDX-ratio indicative equivalent, not a reconstructed ETF NAV fair value
qqq.as_of_discipline: the QQQ price leg uses the close from the same as-of date as the NDX benchmark row, never a later live quote
caveats: expense ratio and tracking difference are disclosed and do not block the number

macro_long_run.source: FOMC SEP June 2026 Table 1 Longer run medians

source_clocks.disclosure_rule: every artifact states the oldest input date beside the result

G1_pole_margin.rule: ke - g >= 0.0300 in every one of the nine cells, for both indices

G2_terminal_share.rule: terminal share of V0 at the Base cell <= 0.90, for both indices

G3_stable_retention.rule: 0 <= g / LTROE <= 1 in every cell, for both indices

G4_finite.rule: all nine cells finite for both indices

G5_monotonicity.rule: value is non-increasing in ERP at fixed LTROE and non-decreasing in LTROE at fixed ERP, and BULL >= BASE >= BEAR, for both indices

G6_terminal_sensitivity.rule: abs(Base(g_low)/Base(g_base) - 1) <= 0.20 and abs(Base(g_high)/Base(g_base) - 1) <= 0.20, for both indices
G6_terminal_sensitivity.note: g_high is clamped by the Rf cap and therefore sits 65 basis points above g_base rather than 100. This is the cap doing its job, not a widened gate.
G6_terminal_sensitivity.replaces: the old E5 F2 discontinuous sign-flip-around-spot gate, which could fail merely because a valuation sat near fair value. The old F2 result is preserved unaltered in the historical-validation record and is not erased.

G7_payout_materiality.rule: payout route A versus B base cell shift <= 0.05 and grid mean shift <= 0.05, ordering preserved under both

G8_implementation_parity.rule: the runtime implementation and an independent handler implementation must agree on every material current number to within 1e-6 relative

disclosures_that_are_not_failures.FAIR_VALUE_OVERLAP: If the g_low..g_high sensitivity envelope for an index crosses that index's current market price, report FAIR_VALUE_OVERLAP. This is a disclosure. A sign test at exactly zero is discontinuous and is not a stability metric.

prohibitions: no terminal family beyond this one; no candidate D, E or F may be introduced after a result
no g, ERP, LTROE, multiplier or offset chosen to reproduce or approach any market price, Yoo output, or historical return
no averaging of official macro sources, and no selecting a source after seeing its valuation
no proxy result may satisfy any READY gate
no synthesized, backfilled or later-inferred input may be classified MODEL_EQUIVALENT
no threshold in this file may move after a result exists
this file is immutable; supersede it with -v2 rather than editing it

terminal is candidate A zero-growth, contradicting the later terminal adjudication

historical_record_is_not_rewritten.meaning: That verdict remains the truthful historical-validation verdict under its own frozen criteria. It is not revised, relaxed or reinterpreted by this file. This file answers a different question: whether the live product is operationally defensible now.

implementation_parity.runtime_requirement: scripts/build-rim-index-final.mjs reads every economic parameter from this file. No economics are restated in the script.
implementation_parity.test_requirement: scripts/test-build-rim-index-final.mjs asserts the script's parameters equal this file's values and that the gate evaluation matches the thresholds recorded here.
implementation_parity.independent_requirement: a handler-owned implementation in a different language re-derives every material current number from this file alone

public_surface.rule: READY does not authorize public promotion. PUBLIC_ROWS stays empty and display_ready stays false until a separate owner approval.
